facts.material: polyester ruler tape; ABS and steel housing/components; magnetic hook
facts.form: 5-meter retractable tape measure marked in inches and centimeters

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9017 covers instruments for measuring length for use in the hand (e.g., measuring rods and tapes)
GRI 6: 9017.80.00.00 other instruments (not drafting, calculating or micrometer/caliper instruments)

rejected_alternatives.reason: micrometers, calipers and gauges; a tape measure is not a gauge
drawing, marking-out or mathematical calculating instruments; the tape measures length
article of plastics; heading 9017 specifically covers hand measuring tapes

classification.rationale: The tape measure is a hand-held instrument for measuring length, which heading 9017 specifically covers. It is not a drafting, calculating or micrometer instrument, so it falls in 9017.80.00.00 (other instruments). CBP classified a retractable tape measure in 9017.80.0000 (G87211, in force).
